reason: I am not paying $1,500 to $3,500 for somebody to tell me what I already know about my own quotes. For a free hour I might listen, but my gut says it turns into a sales pitch.
objection: I keep my quotes on a paper pad and half of my follow-ups never happen, and I already know that. Paying a stranger thousands to point at it does not put a single extra job on the board.
would_change_my_mind: If he showed me, on the free look, two or three quote follow-ups I dropped last month and what that cost me in dollars, then quoted the fix at under a thousand and took the risk of me not paying if it does not work.
